title: QA Engineer Pack project configuration
description: The optional qa.config.json written at a project root. Every field has a documented default; the file exists only to override those defaults. See docs/architecture/ADR-0015-configuration-contract.md.

version.description: Configuration contract major version. Bumped only by a breaking change to this schema.

frameworks.description: Test-framework preferences. Advisory hints the skills read; they never override what a repository actually contains.

preferred.description: Framework to prefer when a project has none yet, or when detection is ambiguous.

browser.description: Default browser preferences for execution and audit skills.

default.description: Browser used when a command does not name one. Defaults to chromium.

output.description: Where skills write machine-readable results and evidence.

directory.description: Artifact output directory, relative to the project root. Defaults to qa-artifacts.

logging.description: Verbosity of the installer CLI and skill progress reporting.

level.description: Minimum level to emit. Defaults to info.

telemetry.description: Reserved. The pack implements no telemetry sink and transmits nothing (see SECURITY.md); this field exists only so that any future, opt-in telemetry is off by contract.

enabled.description: Always defaults to false. No code path currently reads a true value to transmit anything.

plugins.description: Reserved for future third-party knowledge or framework plugins. Currently unused; declared plugins are ignored with a warning.

agents.description: Explicit list of agent ids to install for. When omitted, the installer auto-detects. Values must be known agent ids (see qa doctor).
